title: spatial-edit-audit: controlled simulation and counterfactual audit toolkit for selective local spatial multi-omics edits
description: A deterministic, annotation-blind testbed for evaluating selective local editors on spatial multi-omics sections. It is built on four public tissue sections (11,888 spots partitioned into 593 candidate tiles) and isolates four evaluation artifacts: channel-aggregation versus unilateral decoys, batch-quota coupling, single-pool split-conformal calibration, and static-reference circularity. The package ships the simulation engine, contrast and calibration scorers, external baseline wrappers (SpatialGlue, BANKSY-style neighbourhood smoothing, linear graph diffusion), raw-count and lattice sensitivity checks, and scripts that reproduce every frozen table from offline compressed baselines.
